facts: Parties: Dunmore Engineering Ltd (Buyer), Netherby Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Bellhaven Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 22 April 2027; Closing is scheduled for 8 July 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $133,180,000.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Foxley Logistics plc.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
